paper.ref: Peng L. et al., ACS Energy Lett. 2025, 10, 4004
paper.corr: Liang Ma; Luyi Chen; Lingzhi Zhao; Qifeng Zheng（华南师范大学）

PDD.name: E-PDD
PDD.label: 强溶剂化
PDD.quote: using different electrolytes of 1 M LiTFSI + 0.4 M LiNO3 in PDD, EDD, and DD (denoted as E-PDD, E-EDD, and E-DD, respectively)

EDD.name: E-EDD
EDD.label: 强溶剂化
EDD.quote: DMEU/DOL/DME (2:4:4 by vol., denoted as EDD) and DMPU/DOL/DME (2:4:4 by vol., denoted as PDD)

DD.name: E-DD
DD.label_author: moderately solvating（作者把常规醚称为适中溶剂化）
DD.label: 常规
DD.quote: DOL, which are the representative ether-based solvents with moderately solvating ability for LiPSs

descriptors.mapping_note: 文献溶剂 DN 按体积加权的配方代理
descriptors.object: Li⁺ 溶剂化（溶剂给体数）
descriptors.scale: 溶剂 DN（文献值，本文引用），按体积分数加权
descriptors.comparable_note: 文献 DN 体积加权（代理）；DD 按 1:1 假设；DOL 取 17.5，与 S24 引用的 21.2 不一致
descriptors.quote: the DMPU has a high DN of 34.0 kcal mol−1 … DOL (DN: 17.5 kcal mol−1, μ: 1.19 D) and DME (DN: 20.0 kcal mol−1, μ: 1.72 D) … DMEU, a cyclic solvent with a high DN of 29.0 kcal mol−1

descriptors.mapping_note: 混合溶剂中的 Li2S6（不含 LiTFSI、LiNO₃），按溶剂映射到电池电解液
descriptors.scale: Li2S6 溶液外观（定性：20 mM 是否澄清）
descriptors.unit: 序号（仅表次序；大=溶解多）
descriptors.quote: the 20 mM LiPSs solution in DD appears to be turbid with dark-yellow color, indicating poor solubility of LiPSs

descriptors.mapping_note: 0.1 M Li2S6 混合溶剂体系（不含 LiTFSI、LiNO₃）中作者解释的 Li⁺ 配位方向；加盐后的电池电解液是否同序未验证
descriptors.scale: ⁷Li NMR 化学位移（0.1 M Li2S6 溶于混合溶剂，外标 0.2 M LiCl/DMSO-d6；正文只给方向）
descriptors.unit: 序号（仅表次序；大=上移更多，作者解释为配位更强）
descriptors.comparable_note: 同篇同法：同为 0.1 M Li2S6、同一外标、同一核（⁷Li），描述对象都是 Li⁺ 环境；'上移 = 配位更强'沿用作者解释；只说明该 Li2S6 混合溶剂体系内的方向，加入 1 M LiTFSI + 0.4 M LiNO₃ 后的电池电解液是否保持同样排序未验证。数值只在图 2f，正文只给方向；电池电解液另含 1 M LiTFSI + 0.4 M LiNO₃，按溶剂映射。¹⁷O 比较的是不同分子（DMPU 与 DMEU）的 O 信号，描述对象不同，未采用；DD 未在正文中与二者比较，不赋值
descriptors.quote: Compared with the 0.1 M Li2S6 in EDD (denoted as Li2S6-EDD), the upfield shift of 0.1 M Li2S6 in PDD (denoted as Li2S6−PDD) is remarkable (Figure 2f) … This result confirms the stronger coordination of Li+ with DMPU than that with DMEU

C1.desc: Li‖Li2S6 扣式（溶液正极，碳布）
C1.cathode_material: 碳纤维布 + Li2S6（~1.4 mg S/cm²）
C1.anode_pretreat: 锂负极预处理形成人工 SEI（所有电池）
C1.quote: Li||Li2S6 coin cell was assembled with an electrolyte and sulfur (E/S) ratio of 19 μL mgs−1 … The active mass loading of Li2S6 cathode was controlled at ~1.4 mgs cm−2 … Li-metal anode (LMA) was treated by a pre-protection method to form artificial solid- electrolyte interphases (SEI)

C3.anode_pretreat: 锂负极预处理形成人工 SEI
C3.quote: with a S mass loading of 2.1 mg cm−2 and a low E/S ratio of 12.8

C4.anode_pretreat: 锂负极预处理形成人工 SEI
C4.quote: with a high S mass loading of 4.4 mg cm−2 and low E/S ratio of 5.0 μL mg−1 at 0.1 C

C5.desc: Li‖Li 对称电池（1 mA/cm²，1 mAh/cm²）
C5.anode_pretreat: 锂负极预处理形成人工 SEI
C5.quote: The electrolyte amount for each cell was 40 μL. The cycling stability of Li||Li symmetric cell was tested at a current density of 1 mA cm–2 with a capacity of 1 mAh cm–2

comparisons.author_judgement: PDD 倍率远高于另两者
comparisons.quote: high capacities of 1313, 1244, 1203, 1149, and 1004 mAh g−1 at rates of 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5, and 1 C, respectively, which are much higher than those using E-EDD and E-DD

comparisons.author_judgement: DD 穿梭腐蚀负极 + Li2S 过早钝化
comparisons.reason_quote: could be ascribed to the severe parasitic reaction between shuttled LiPSs and LMA as well as premature Li2S passivation
comparisons.quote: demonstrates a high capacity of 876 mAh g−1 and very stable cycling stability with 82% capacity retained after 80 cycles. In stark contrast, the Li||S cell using E-DD electrolyte displays rapid capacity decay with only 23% capacity retained after 80 cycles
